prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1004; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you the facts of what happened, if that's all right.

Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved?

A: Yes, I was driving my own car.

Q: Where were you when the collision occurred?

A: I was in Houston, Texas, at an intersection with a traffic signal. I was trying to make a left turn.

Q: Walk me through what you were doing just before impact.

A: I was waiting in the turn lane for a gap in oncoming traffic. When it looked clear, I started into the turn, and then a vehicle coming straight through hit the front passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started your turn?

A: I saw headlights further back, but I thought there was enough room. I misjudged how fast it was coming.

Q: What was the signal showing for you when you began the turn?

A: It had changed to green for the through traffic, and my arrow had turned to a yield. I believed I could complete the turn safely.

Q: Did you feel any pain or injury immediately afterward?

A: My shoulder hurt right away, mostly the right one. It got worse over the next day or so, and I've been having trouble lifting my arm.

Q: Have you received medical treatment for that shoulder?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic and I've been referred for follow-up care.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want to cooperate fully and get my vehicle and my medical situation sorted out.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
